lessonTitle: Acts Chapter 23 — Paul Before the Sanhedrin / Plot and Transfer

questions.questionText: Paul looked straight at the Sanhedrin and said, My brothers, I have fulfilled my duty to God in all good conscience to this day. Who ordered those standing near Paul to strike him on the mouth?
Then Paul said to him, God will strike you, you whitewashed wall! What did others say?
options: How dare you insult God’s high priest!

questions.questionText: Paul said he did not realize Ananias was the high priest, for it is written, Do not speak evil about the ruler of your people. Then Paul noticed the Sanhedrin was divided. Which two groups?
Paul said he was on trial because of the hope of the resurrection of the dead. What happened?
options: A dispute broke out between the Pharisees and the Sadducees

questions.questionText: The Sadducees say there is no resurrection, and that there are neither angels nor spirits, but the Pharisees believe what?

There was a great uproar. Some teachers of the law who were Pharisees stood up and declared, We find nothing wrong with this man. What if a spirit or an angel has spoken to him? The commander was afraid Paul would be what?
The following night the Lord stood near Paul and said, Take courage! As you have testified about me in Jerusalem, so you must also testify in where?
The next morning some Jews formed a conspiracy and bound themselves with an oath not to eat or drink until they had killed Paul. How many were in this plot?
They went to the chief priests and the elders and said they were ready to kill Paul when?
options: When the Sanhedrin petitions the commander to bring Paul before them

questions.questionText: The son of Paul’s sister heard of this plot. What did he do?
options: He went into the barracks and told Paul

questions.questionText: Paul called one of the centurions and said, Take this young man to the commander; he has something to tell him. The commander took him by the hand and asked privately. What did the young man say?
options: The Jews have agreed to ask you to bring Paul… They are ready to kill him

questions.questionText: The commander dismissed the young man and warned him, Don’t tell anyone that you have reported this to me. Then he called two centurions and ordered what?
options: Get ready a detachment of two hundred soldiers, seventy horsemen and two hundred spearmen to go to Caesarea at nine tonight
Send Paul to Rome that hour without a letter

questions.questionText: Provide horses for Paul so that he may be taken safely to Governor whom?
I wrote a letter: Claudius Lysias, To His Excellency, Governor Felix. Who am I?
Lysias wrote he rescued Paul when he learned Paul was a what?
Lysias found the accusation had to do with questions about their law, but there was no charge against him that deserved what?
The soldiers, carrying out their orders, took Paul during the night and brought him as far as where?

The next day they let the cavalry go on with him, while they returned to the barracks. When the cavalry arrived in Caesarea, they delivered the letter to the governor and handed Paul over to him. Felix asked what province Paul was from. Hearing Cilicia he said he would hear the case when?
Felix ordered Paul to be kept under guard in whose palace?
True or false: Paul said he was a Pharisee, descended from Pharisees.
options: True — but he denied the resurrection

questions.questionText: I am the high priest who ordered Paul struck on the mouth. Who am I?
Paul called Ananias a _____ wall.
True or false: The Lord told Paul he must testify in Rome.
How many men bound themselves with an oath to kill Paul?
I am Paul’s nephew who heard the plot. Who am I?
How many soldiers were to get ready besides seventy horsemen and two hundred spearmen?
At what time were they to leave?
Paul was taken safely to which governor?
I am His Excellency the governor who received the letter. Who am I?
The infantry returned from which town while cavalry went on?
options: Jerusalem barracks immediately without a stop

questions.questionText: Paul was from which province?
True or false: Lysias said he found nothing deserving death or imprisonment.
options: False — he said Paul must die
True — so he freed Paul at once

questions.questionText: Who took the young man by the hand aside privately?
The commander told the young man not to tell anyone that he had reported this. Then he wrote to whom?
True or false: Some Pharisees said they found nothing wrong with Paul.
Who transferred Paul to the barracks during the Sanhedrin fight?
Paul was kept under guard in which palace?
options: Caesar’s palace in Rome this chapter

questions.questionText: I formed a conspiracy and asked the Sanhedrin to help us by requesting Paul be brought. Who are we?
options: The more than forty men under oath

questions.questionText: The Lord stood near Paul at night and told him to take courage. Where must he also testify?
The soldiers took Paul by night as far as Antipatris. Where did the cavalry then take him?
